reproducibility_gaps: The external Office dataset payload was not downloaded or inspected, so asset integrity and end-to-end data availability were not verified.
The archive has no dependency manifest or native-extension build instructions; bundled historical MEX binaries and MATLAB R2009b/Linux documentation do not establish current portability.
The five-run workflow performs sample selection without an explicit random seed in the inspected entrypoint or configuration files.
The README gives one illustrative accuracy table, but expected results are not specified for all eight configurations.
notes: R2 reflects accessible source, license, a documented historical environment, entrypoint, usage steps and explicit configurations, with external-data and portability gaps preventing R3.
